pages.inheritance_note: Single-page React 18 + Vite SPA: index.html is the only literal head source and is served for every route via the Vercel catch-all rewrite (vercel.json: "/(.*)" -> "/index.html"). src/main.jsx mounts into #root; src/App.jsx selects a page component from window.location.pathname (ternary chain at lines 418-424) and passes no head metadata to any page. No document.title assignment, document.head mutation, /<meta> JSX, react-helmet/next-head style dependency, metadata export or head composable exists in the captured source, so all routes inherit the same static title "Lakshay Goyal — Software Engineer", meta description, viewport, charset, favicon and font links; no route overrides or templates them. PageHeading({eyebrow,title,description}) in src/App.jsx renders visible <h2>/<p> copy only and is not a head declaration. BlogPostPage strips YAML front matter from /blog/<slug>.md before rendering, so the markdown title and image are never applied to the document head; they are recorded with scope "markdown-frontmatter-not-applied-to-head". public/blog/blog.json titles are content-index values (scope "content-index-not-head"). No canonical, hreflang, Open Graph, Twitter card, robots or JSON-LD declarations were observed anywhere in the captured source.
